summary: Anteris Technologies Global Corp., through its wholly owned subsidiary, notified v2vmedtech, inc. of its election to discontinue additional development contributions under their Contribution and Stock Purchase Agreement dated April 18, 2023, terminating the agreement after completing Stage 1 and during Stage 2. The break fee is $400,000 payable to v2v. v2v's initial shareholders can either acquire Anteris' equity interest for the aggregate contributions made or reduce Anteris' stake to a capped minority percentage. Accordingly, this Item 1.02 filing reports termination of a material definitive agreement.
